main_measure.name: one-sample t of mean excess next-day return on bars with forecast >= 5
main_measure.threshold: confirm if t >= 2 with >= 30 cases and convexity check passes; reject if t <= -2 with >= 30 cases

supporting_check.name: per-unit-forecast mean excess return, group >= 5 minus group 0 < f < 5

decided_by: The main t is between -2 and 2.
reading: The per-unit-forecast return of each group is taken as the group's mean excess return divided by its mean forecast; 'between 0 and 5' is read as 0 < forecast < 5; every bar is a case, since the 1-bar horizon grid holds every bar; and the coin's mean is that of all its within-window daily returns.
